text:
Zoe Park: Heads-up from the harrier-v1-int8 onboarding canary: structured-output rejects due to duplicate object keys in funcall payloads. Only on streaming + sampling temp>0.8.
Ethan Moore: Duplicate keys? Can you paste the raw emission?
Zoe Park: Example (raw stream fragment):
```
{"tool":"extract","args":{"id":123, "id":456}}
```
Ling Wang: Yikes. Two `id` fields in the same object. Some JSON parsers may accept last-write-wins, but our strict schema validator errors on duplicates. Failure rate ~0.7% over 12k canary calls. Non-quant baseline had 0%.
Ravi Desai: Any token trace? Could be model rephrasing or stochastic repeats.
Zoe Park: Token snippet: `[TOK_5001]="\"id\"" [TOK_5002]="\":\"123\"" ... [TOK_5005]="\"id\"" [TOK_5006]="\":\"456\""`  model emits second key after a brief prose-like interjection.
Ethan Moore: This might be because the model is trying to "correct" earlier value mid-generation (common with high-temp sampling). Why only streaming? The chunk boundary maybe splits and the second key appears as an appended mini-object.
Ling Wang: Also interesting: duplicates often have different value types (string vs int) which trips strict schema checks.
Zoe Park: Proposed short-term gatekeeper modes: 1) `reject_on_duplicate_keys` (default), 2) `dedupe_last_wins`, 3) `dedupe_first_wins`, 4) `fail_with_debug` (collect raw bytes and fail). Make `dedupe_*` modes explicitly opt-in for canaries only.
Ethan Moore: If we opt for `dedupe_last_wins` we should add telemetry tags `coercion.duplicate_key=last_wins` and keep samples of original payloads. Also add a rate-limited audit log for human review.
Ravi Desai: Long-term we should add an onboarding eval that measures "duplicate-key frequency" and penalizes models in scorecard. Also vary temperature and sampling seeds to see correlation.
Ling Wang: Implementation note: dedupe should only run on object-scoped duplicates, not on nested arrays where duplicates might be intended (rare but possible). Also maintain a mapping of key order to detect suspicious patterns.
Zoe Park: Quick plan: Zoe will attach sample traces + canary config (temp, batch, stream). Ethan will prototype gatekeeper dedupe_last_wins with telemetry. Ling will add an onboarding eval to the canary suite to measure duplicate-key rate across sampling temperatures. Ravi will add a dashboard slice and alert if dedupe_coercion_rate>0.25%.
Ethan Moore: I'll make PR but mark `dedupe_last_wins` behind feature-flag `structured_output.duplicate_key_coercion` and default off. We'll enable in staging on harrier-v1-int8 for 48h for observation.
Ling Wang: On the eval side I'll run a parameter sweep: temps 0.0,0.3,0.6,0.9 and seeds 1..10, measure duplicate_key_rate and functional regression vs baseline. If duplicates correlate with temp>0.6, we may recommend lower sampling for structured routes.
Zoe Park: Also add a token-boundary fuzz that inserts partial key repeats to ensure runtime chunking doesn't amplify this.
Ravi Desai: I'll create dashboard widgets: `duplicate_key_rate`, `dedupe_coercion_rate`, `post_coercion_success_rate`, and a small UX that links to raw-sample view. Alert if pre-coercion duplicate_key_rate > 0.5% for a sustained window.
query-bot: [automated] canary 3210000000 recorded: 12000 requests, duplicate_key_rate=0.007, dedupe_coercion_enabled=false.
Ethan Moore: One more thought: we should consider adding an explicit model-output hint in onboarding prompts asking models to avoid duplicate keys, similar to our `__call_id` pattern. But that might not be reliable.
Ling Wang: Agree. Prefer runtime controls + onboarding eval first. If pattern persists across models, we add a required prompt-scaffold for structured routes.
Zoe Park: Action items recap:
- Zoe: upload token traces + canary config (today)
- Ethan: gatekeeper PR for dedupe_last_wins + feature flag + telemetry (taking)
- Ling: onboarding sweep across temps+seeds + fuzz harness (taking)
- Ravi: dashboard slices + alert rule (taking)
Zoe Park: If dedupe_coercion_rate > 0.25% in staging we'll hold harrier-v1-int8 for further model tuning.
Ethan Moore: Will ping when PR is up for review.
Ling Wang: Thanks everyone.
Ravi Desai: Thanks :thumbsup:
